descriptions.text: Blitz Stick. It's like candy, but for your mind. If you eat this, your Intelligence temporarily rises by five points. If you smoke it, there's a 15% chance your Intelligence will permanently rise by 1. There might be a side effect or two. Or three.

recap.text: Quint, the Desperado Club's drug dealer on duty, comes over after the waitress says the club has no earth tobacco but does stock blitz sticks. Mordecai warns Carl off them as magically addictive hallucinogens, then buys himself a starter kit with three bottles of moonshine. Quint adds three licorice-looking blitz sticks on the house, and Carl pulls them into his inventory before Mordecai can object.

Hump Town's dromedarian gatekeeper wants payment in gold or drugs. Donut straightens on Carl's shoulder, sensing a deal, but Carl holds up a hand to stop her and offers one blitz stick, one of the couple he got from Quint. The camel squints at it, pops it in his mouth and lights it. He waves them in, warns them off city hall, and wanders away smoking it, showing it proudly to another camel.

Daniel tells Katia she is squeezing too tight and hurting him, and she pulls a blitz stick and lights it. The sticks came off Sally, a healer who worked at the airport and turned to Eva despite everything, one of Eva's victims, now dead like the rest. Eva left the drugs as the only thing in Sally's inventory, a present for Katia and a trap. Katia thinks "Show me Annie," and the blitz stick obliges, every time.

Mordecai tells Katia what she has been taking: blitz sticks, which work like weed with a hallucinogen that shows her memories that never happened, and that is why they are so damn addictive. The cure is a patch she will have to wear on her skin, and Imani has it ready. Katia has been on the blitz for a while, so it will be hard to get out of her system.

Weeper Commander Volteeg drives his tank toward the warlord's caravan. The warlord protests that he is getting too close, and Volteeg answers that he knows, and that is the point. He picks up a blitz stick, pops it into his mouth and lights it, then says to himself, Show me Mistress Henspar.

beats.headline: Three on the house
beats.text: The Desperado Club has no earth tobacco, the waitress says, but it has blitz sticks: shall she send a pharmacist over? Carl declines. Mordecai sends for Quint, the drug dealer on duty, and tells Carl to stay away from them: hallucinogens, magically addictive. Three bottles of moonshine buy Mordecai a starter kit. Then Quint throws in three licorice sticks on the house, not earth tobacco but worth a try: blitz sticks. Carl pulls them into his inventory before Mordecai can object.
beats.gist: Quint, the drug dealer, throws in three free blitz sticks, hallucinogens, and Carl pockets them before Mordecai objects.

beats.headline: Gold or drugs
beats.text: To get into Hump Town a dromedarian wants payment, gold or drugs, the dungeon's version of the old bumper sticker. Donut senses a deal and straightens on Carl's shoulder; he holds up a hand to stop her and holds up a single blitz stick instead, one of the couple he got from Quint. The camel squints at it, pops it in his mouth and lights it. Good shit. Welcome to Hump Town, and stay out of city hall. He wanders off smoking it and shows it proudly to another camel.
beats.gist: A dromedarian wants gold or drugs at Hump Town, so Carl offers a blitz stick.

beats.headline: Show me Annie
beats.text: Before the party, Daniel told Katia she was squeezing too tight and hurting him. After that, she pulled a blitz stick and lit it. Only Daniel knows: it is one of her two big secrets in this dungeon. She found the sticks on Sally, one of Eva's victims, a healer who had worked at the airport and turned to Eva despite everything. She is dead now, like the rest of them. The drugs were the only thing left in her inventory. Eva left them there, a present for Katia, and a trap. Show me Annie, Katia thinks, and the blitz stick obliges. Every time.
beats.gist: Daniel tells Katia she is squeezing too tight, and she lights a blitz stick from Eva's trap.

beats.headline: Memories that never happened
beats.text: Mordecai sets out what Katia has been taking. Blitz sticks are like weed plus a hallucinogen that shows you memories that do not exist, which is why they are so damn addictive. The cure is a patch she will have to wear on her skin for a while, and Imani has it ready to go. Katia has been on the blitz for a while, so it is going to be hard to get out of her system.
beats.gist: Mordecai says blitz sticks give Katia weed-like highs and false memories; Imani has a patch ready.

beats.headline: Show me Mistress Henspar
beats.text: Weeper Commander Volteeg drives his tank toward the warlord's caravan. You're getting too close to my caravan, the warlord protests. I know, Volteeg answers. That's the point. He reaches down and picks up a blitz stick, pops it into his mouth, lights it, and says to himself, Show me Mistress Henspar.
beats.gist: Volteeg lights a blitz stick in his mouth as his tank nears the warlord's caravan.
